crosscutting.name: Safety & Alignment
crosscutting.summary: Making models and agents behave as intended and avoid harm, from training data to deployed apps.

crosscutting.name: Evaluation
crosscutting.summary: Measuring what systems can do and how reliably, at every layer: benchmarks, red-teaming, production monitoring.

crosscutting.name: Cost & Economics
crosscutting.summary: Energy, chips, training runs and per-token prices: cost shapes decisions at every layer.

headline.label: Big Tech capital spending, last reported quarter
headline.note: Combined capital expenditure reported by Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta, each as the company defines it (Microsoft and Meta include finance leases). Roughly double the same quarter of 2025. Not all of it is AI, and filings don't split it by layer.
headline.source: Q2 2026 earnings releases (Microsoft FY26 Q4) of Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta, published 22 to 30 July 2026

crosscutting.name: Governance & Regulation
crosscutting.summary: Laws, standards, licences and export controls that constrain what can be built and deployed.

crosscutting.name: Security
crosscutting.summary: Protecting every layer from attack: supply chain, infrastructure, model files, prompt injection and agent permissions.
